business_problem: eDoctor needed to improve multilingual medical communication and content production without sacrificing rigor. International medical meetings required simultaneous translation and fast summaries, while the company also had to generate accurate medical content, subtitles, and searchable course assets at scale for pharmaceutical and healthcare audiences.
solution_summary: eDoctor integrated Alibaba Cloud Bailian into its medical-marketing and medical-education platform so multilingual meetings, video courses, and medical content workflows could be handled on one AI stack. Bailian's multimodal models are used on live medical exchanges to generate subtitles, support simultaneous interpretation, and produce rapid meeting summaries that reduce language barriers in international collaboration. On the Tuomai platform, eDoctor also uses Bailian supervised fine-tuning (SFT) to adapt model behavior for medically rigorous content, improving correctness and tone instead of relying on generic responses. The same LLM layer extends into a content-creation center for medical UGC and into a course repository where Bailian Agent summarizes lesson essentials and powers site-wide retrieval across stored medical videos. That architecture makes translation, summarization, search, and content drafting reusable services inside one healthcare-information platform.

solution_components.name: Bailian multimodal models
solution_components.role: Handle speech, subtitle, translation, and summary generation for medical meetings and media assets.

solution_components.name: Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT)
solution_components.role: Adapts the base model so generated medical content is more accurate and rigorous for healthcare use.

solution_components.name: Tuomai platform
solution_components.role: Hosts the meeting, course, and medical-content workflows that consume Bailian outputs.

solution_components.name: Bailian Agent
solution_components.role: Summarizes course essentials and powers site-wide retrieval across stored medical learning content.

data_flow: Live meeting audio, recorded courses, and medical content assets flow through Bailian multimodal models for transcription, translation, summarization, and content generation. SFT-tuned model behavior is then applied inside the Tuomai platform, where outputs are published to users or indexed by Bailian Agent for course summary and search workflows.
business_outcome: eDoctor upgraded its healthcare-information products without scaling content labor linearly. Bailian reduced the manual effort required for subtitles, translation, summarization, and content drafting, improved the competitiveness of the Tuomai platform, and extended eDoctor's reach across medical meetings, live streams, and training assets while preserving the rigor required in medical communication.
architecture_clues: The production design combines multimodal inference, supervised fine-tuning, and Agent-based retrieval instead of relying on a single generic model endpoint.
Course repositories are turned into a searchable knowledge layer by pairing stored media with AI summaries and retrieval.
Medical-content generation is tuned for correctness and rigor before outputs are exposed to users.
